outcome: Prevalence of low birth weight infants
cohort: Participants were newborns of both genders with a gestational age of 22 to 42 weeks and birth weight less than 2,500 grams, born in the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina in 2009.
finding: The study determined a relatively low prevalence of low birth weight infants (2.9%) in the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina in 2009 and characterized their associated obstetrical features.
mod_finding: Of the low birth weight infants, 61.4% were born per vias naturalis (vaginally) with cephalic presentation.
